verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Who is this King of Glory?
The God who became man
Who is this One we wait for?
The Holy Spotless Lamb

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Your eyes are like fire
Your hair is like wool
You're Zealous and Holy
You're wonderful

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
Here in this moment
I'm caught in Your gaze
I'm ready to meet you
My King is on His way

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Receive the fragrance
Our worship releases
Rising to Heaven
All for you Jesus

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You are the King of Glory
The One who conquered death
And now You reign in victory
All praise unto the lamb

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Worthy are You Lord
Worthy are You Lord
Worthy are You Lord
All glory, and honor, and power is Yours
